description: Opens Enpitech's AgentReady scanner as a view in the conversation. Inside the view the scanner fetches the site's public pages and runs 21 checks across five weighted categories (Discovery & Access, Readable for Agents, Structured Data, Actions & MCP, Trust & Safety), then shows a 0-100 agent-readiness score, the per-category breakdown, and the fixes ranked by the points each would recover. Use it when the user asks how ready a website is for AI agents, their own or any site they name: how readable, accessible or usable it is to AI, to agents or to AI crawlers; whether ChatGPT or Claude can read or use it; how to show up in AI answers; or for an audit of llms.txt, robots.txt, schema.org markup or MCP support. url is optional: with no URL the scanner opens with an empty input for the user to fill in. This tool returns only the URL it was opened with; the scan runs inside the view, via agentready_scan.

url.description: The site to scan, as the user gave it. A bare hostname like stripe.com is fine; the scanner normalizes it. Omit when the user has not named a site, and they will be asked for one.

name: agent_ready

url.description: The site the scanner opened with, or an empty string when the user will type one in the view.

title: Check Agent Readiness
